goal: Deprecate encrypting existing unencrypted wallets via RPC
Prevent fund loss from invalidated backups, altered spending conditions, and key remnants on disk
agreement: Strong support with multiple ACKs and no open objections
Support because creating a new encrypted wallet and moving funds is cleaner and safer (pablomartin4btc)
Approvals on the approach and implementation (achow101, pablomartin4btc, w0xlt)
Minor suggestions on docs, comments, and release notes were addressed (fanquake, maflcko)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because encrypting an existing wallet risks fund loss if restoring from older backups
Avoids changing descriptor spending conditions unexpectedly and leaving unencrypted key remnants on disk
